steps.what: List delinquent accounts past the stored due date.
Review the notice the taxpayer will receive.
Send the accepted notice to the taxpayer.

tasks.design: Delinquent accounts are listed in the {ERP} only when the balance and the due date are both stored and the balance is past the published threshold. The revenue agent reviews the notice. It is sent by {EMAIL} only for the version the agent accepted. A missing date stops the line. No score chooses the account.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notices were printed from a list that mixed current and closed accounts.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored balance and a stored due date can be compared before the agent reads the notice.
tasks.still_hard: An account whose balance is past due for a reason the threshold does not know.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a past-due balance that should not receive this notice.
tasks.altitude: Past-due accounts are listed from stored dates. The agent still reviews every notice. Nothing is sent before that acceptance.

reach.task: Send a written notice only after the person accepts that version.
reach.learn: The list can be prepared. The send stays gated here.

evidence.claim: A past-due balance can be listed from a stored balance and a stored due date. The list cannot choose the wording of the notice.
EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, and a determining score counts. The agent accepts the version before a notice or a refund goes out.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Account id, balance, and due date, produced by the tax ledger. An account with no due date is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the ledger the office already keeps. No score is stored.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the revenue agent.
unknowns: Which notices must also go by post.
research_questions: What share of accounts have a stored due date?
Who may accept a notice besides the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still reviews the notice.

incremental.description: The agent rewrites a notice whose balance was corrected.

approvals.approved_version: notice version and the account ids the notice cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing accounts whose balance and due date are already stored. It disappears when the date is missing and the agent rebuilds the list. Reviewing and accepting the notice stay with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with taxpayers about the return.

steps.what: List the return issues already stored on the case.
Confer with the taxpayer and discuss the regulations.
Record how the return problem was resolved.

tasks.design: Issues already stored on the return are listed from {DOCS} before the conference. The revenue agent confers with the taxpayer or the representative, discusses the regulations, and resolves the problem. The list does not resolve the return. An issue with no case id is not prepared.
tasks.previous_blocker: Conferences started from memory of the return, and the note was written afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored issues can be listed before the call.
tasks.still_hard: A representative who raises a point the file does not contain.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can hear that a stored issue is not the problem to resolve.
tasks.altitude: The known issues are listed before the call. The agent still confers and still records the resolution. The list is not the conference.

reach.task: Read the file before discussing a dispute with the person.
reach.learn: The issues can be listed. The conference stays here.

evidence.claim: Stored issues can be listed before a conference. The list cannot discuss the law or resolve the return.
The conference stays with the agent. A listed issue is not a resolution.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.
Fields: Case id and issue id, produced by the case file. A case with no issue id is not given a list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the case file the office already keeps.
unknowns: Which conferences must be in person.
research_questions: What share of cases have stored issues?
Which problems are always resolved on the call?

already_counted.description: The agent still confers and discusses the regulations.
The agent still records the resolution.

incremental.description: The agent adds an issue the list did not contain.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing issues already on the case. It disappears when the case has no issue id and the agent prepares from the return. The conference stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Notify taxpayers of a refund or a further payment.

steps.what: Compute the overpayment or underpayment from stored amounts.
Review whether to issue a refund or request payment.
Notify the taxpayer of the accepted amount.

tasks.design: The overpayment or underpayment is computed in the {ERP} only when the return amount and the assessment amount are both stored. The revenue agent reviews whether to issue a refund or request further payment. The taxpayer is notified only of the accepted version. A missing amount stops the line. The difference does not issue the refund.
tasks.previous_blocker: Refunds were calculated on a side sheet and sometimes paid against the wrong assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Two stored amounts can be compared before the agent decides.
tasks.still_hard: A difference that is arithmetically right and still should not be paid.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a correct overpayment that belongs to another period.
tasks.altitude: Known differences are computed. The agent still decides between a refund and a further payment. Nothing is issued before that acceptance.

reach.role: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
reach.task: Compute a difference from two stored amounts and still decide whether to pay it.
reach.learn: The arithmetic can be prepared. The refund decision stays with the agent.

evidence.claim: An overpayment can be computed from a stored return amount and a stored assessment. The difference cannot issue a refund.
EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, and a determining score counts. The agent accepts the version before a notice or a refund goes out.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Return amount id and assessment amount id, produced by the ledger. A case with either id missing is not computed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the ledger the office already keeps.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the revenue agent.
unknowns: Which notices go by post as well as mail.
research_questions: What share of cases have both amounts stored?
Which refunds need a second person?

already_counted.description: The agent still reviews the refund or the payment request.

incremental.description: The agent recomputes a case whose assessment was corrected.

approvals.approved_version: refund version and the amounts the calculation cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the difference where both amounts are already stored. It disappears when an amount is missing and the agent calculates by hand. Issuing the refund or requesting payment stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain the case record of contacts and actions.

steps.what: File a case contact when the telephone number is present.
Maintain case records the file could not place.
Check the actions taken on that case record.

tasks.design: A contact is filed in {DOCS} when the case id, the telephone number, and the action are already on the note. The revenue agent maintains the records that have no case id and checks the actions taken. The log stores no score of the agent. A note with a missing id is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contacts lived in a notebook and were typed into the case days later, sometimes on the wrong taxpayer.
tasks.enabler_now: A note that already has a case id and a telephone number can be filed once.
tasks.still_hard: A call that covered two cases, and an action the note does not name.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can tell which case a messy note belongs to.
tasks.altitude: Complete contacts are on the case the day they are written. The agent still places the notes that have no id and still checks the actions. No score is stored.

reach.task: File an action on a case without scoring the person who did it.
reach.learn: The contact can be filed. The unplaced note stays here.

evidence.claim: A contact note with a case id and a telephone number can be filed once. A note with no case id cannot be placed.
The case log stores contacts and actions on the case. It stores no score of the agent. Works-council consent covers monitoring of staff behaviour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Case id, telephone number, and action, produced by the contact note. A note with no case id is not filed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the case store the office already keeps. This task stores no skill score.
unknowns: How long case contacts are kept.
Who else may add an action.
research_questions: What share of notes already have a case id?
Which actions must be checked by a second person?

already_counted.description: The agent still maintains records that have no case id.
The agent still checks the actions taken.

incremental.description: The agent moves a contact that was filed on the wrong case.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is filing a contact that already has a case id and a telephone number. It disappears when the id is missing and the agent places the note. Checking the actions stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The agent still confers with the taxpayer and still accepts a notice before it is sent. A past-due balance and a stored overpayment can be listed before that work.
reach: Environmental compliance inspectors send a notice only after a person signs the version, and this job learns the same gate on a tax notice.
Regulatory affairs specialists keep a case record of actions without scoring the person, and this job learns the case log is not a behaviour score.
skills_to_grow: Accept a notice version before it is sent.
Keep the conference with the taxpayer.
role.ambitious_version: Past-due accounts and stored differences are listed before the agent looks at them, and nothing is sent before that person accepts the version.
